question: Name the freedom fighter who became the editor of the communist journal 'Vangaurd'.
solution:
The correct answer is __**M.N. Roy**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The freedom fighter who became the editor of the communist journal *Vanguard* is **M.N. Roy**.
 
• He **was involved in revolutionary activities** aimed at overthrowing British colonial rule in India.
 
• After his initial involvement in the Indian independence struggle, **he became disillusioned with the methods of the Indian National Congress and turned towards Marxism and revolutionary politics.**
 
• **In 1920, M.N. Roy became associated with the Communist movement** and was a founding member of the Communist International (Comintern), an organization aimed at promoting global socialist revolution.
 
• He was **deeply influenced by Marxist ideology, and in 1925**,** he became the editor of *Vanguard*, **a communist journal that was instrumental in promoting Marxist ideas in India and abroad.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **C. Rajagopalachari****​**

 
 
• C. Rajagopalachari, popularly known as Rajaji, was the last governor-general of India. 

 
 
• C. Rajagopalachari succeeded Lord Mountbatten as governor-general of India from 1948 to 1950. 
 
• After C.Rajagopalachari, the title of the governor was abolished and replaced by the President of India. 
 
• C. Rajagopalachari also has the distinction of being the first Indian governor-general of India.
 
 
 
 
 
• **K. Kelappan**
 
 
• K. Kelappan was a founding member and president of the Nair Service Society a reformer, an Indian freedom fighter, educationist and journalist.
 
• He is also known as Kerala Gandhi.
 
• He was actively involved in Vaikom Satyagraha and also walked from Calicut to Payannur to break salt law in response to Salt Satyagraha.
 
• He took up the question of temple entry in 1931 during the period when the Civil Disobedience Movement was suspended.
 
 
 
• P Krishna Pillai
 
 
• He was an active volunteer of Vaikom Satyagraha (1924).
 
• He also participated in the Salt Satyagraha march from Kozhikode to Payyanur (1930).
